correctness.rationale: For K_a=B(ae₁,1)∩B(−ae₁,1), 0≤a<1, section integration yields area 2(acos a−a√(1−a²)). The two-branch support h(θ)=1−a cosθ for θ≤acos a, and √(1−a²)sinθ otherwise, gives polar area by 2∫h(θ)^{-2}dθ = (π+4a)/(1−a²)^{3/2}. The derivative is 2H(a)/(1−a²)^{5/2}; H(0)=H(1−)=0, H′(0)<0, H′ positive near 1, and H″=16acos a−6π√(1−a²) changes sign exactly once, forcing H<0. The affine scaling x/(1−a), y/√(2(1−a)) converges to |X|+Y²≤1 and Mahler product 4(π+4)/3. Independently numerically integrated both polar support branches for a=0,.125,.4,.7,.9 and matched closed formula. Strict all-a monotonicity is proved analytically, not by sampling.
